install: sh -c 'if [ -f scripts/bootstrap.sh ]; then exec env SKIP_CURSOR_INSTALL=1 sh scripts/bootstrap.sh; fi; cd repos/thunderstone-starter && exec env SKIP_CURSOR_INSTALL=1 sh scripts/bootstrap.sh'
start: sh -c 'if [ -f scripts/resume.sh ]; then exec bash scripts/resume.sh; fi; cd repos/thunderstone-starter && exec bash scripts/resume.sh'
